0.name: EXCEL_EPOCH
0.docs: Days between Excel's day zero (in its 1900 system) and 1970-01-01.

351.name: size
351.docs: Font size in hundredths of a point; zero for a cell without text.

99.name: FlowDrawing
99.docs:
Shapes placed as one picture, such as a chart or a barcode. Coordinates stay those of the
page, so `page_rect` is what they are drawn from.

249.name: DRAWING_SCALE
249.docs: Pixels per point when rasterizing drawings: sharp enough for a scanner on paper.

424.name: Placed
424.docs: A text placed on the grid.

247.name: extent
247.docs: The top and bottom of an item.

423.name: url
423.docs: The address the cell opens, when it is a link.

396.name: Formats
396.docs: One format per distinct look: workbooks have a limit, and it keeps files small.

420.name: block
420.docs: `None` once two controls share the cell: its value is then just text.

445.name: ravenrs_report_xlsx

444.name: sheet_name
444.docs:
A sheet name Excel accepts: at most 31 characters, none of `[]:*?/\`, and
not starting or ending in an apostrophe.

16.name: XlsxExportError
16.docs: Why a document could not be written as XLSX.

41.name: into
41.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

15.name: Workbook
15.docs: The workbook writer refused the content, for example past Excel's row limit.

89.name: to_csv
89.docs:
Writes `document` as CSV: one record per line of the report, one field per
column of text, with the text as printed. Fields are separated by `;` in
cultures whose decimal separator is a comma and by `,` in the others, and
records end in CRLF.

289.name: merge
289.docs: Adds what `other` sets; used to give a merged cell the borders of its parts.

12.name: translate_date
12.docs: Translates a .NET date pattern to Excel's letters.

288.name: CellStyle
288.docs: Fill and borders of a cell.

11.name: date_format
11.docs: The Excel format for a date specifier; `None` when Excel has no equivalent.

86.name: to_xlsx
86.docs: Writes `document` as an XLSX workbook with one sheet.

10.name: custom_number_section
10.docs: A custom section such as `R$ #,##0.00`, with the literal text around the digits quoted.

85.name: PIXELS_PER_POINT
85.docs: Pixels per point in Excel's column widths.

9.name: number_format
9.docs: The Excel format for a number specifier; `None` when Excel has no equivalent.

84.name: FONT
84.docs: The closest font to the report's Inter that every spreadsheet program has.

83.name: RULE_SNAP
83.docs: A rule this close to a grid line, in points, borders it instead of adding a row.

82.name: SNAP
82.docs: Edges closer than this, in points, are one grid line.

258.name: rows
258.docs: The number of cells between the lines.

257.name: span
257.docs: The cells between two edges, at least one.

357.name: Look
357.docs: Everything a cell's format depends on.

256.name: nearest
256.docs: The index of the grid line nearest to `edge`.

280.name: Rgb
280.docs: A color as `0xRRGGBB`, translucent colors blended over the white page.

2.name: typed
2.docs:
The number to store for `value` and its Excel format, or `None` when the
cell should keep the printed text.

102.name: Flow
102.docs: The document's pages flowed into one long page.

253.name: Grid
253.docs: Sorted grid lines on one axis.

1.name: format
1.docs:
Turns a report's values and .NET-style format specifiers into what a
spreadsheet stores: a number and an Excel number format.
